name: Runner Extras - Dialog Progress Window No-Op
brief: Regression test: opening/updating/closing a progress Dialog is a faithful headless no-op and the AL code after Dialog.Open runs identically.
description: Proves NavDialog.ALOpenAsync no longer NREs on the headless skeleton session. A BC progress window carries no return value the business logic branches on, so Dialog.Open/Update/Close must succeed silently and the surrounding AL must run to completion and produce a concrete value.
